scope: Graduation-critical build tags and environment controls.

entries.gate: Equivalent physical heads retain every node, error region, lineage, and checkpoint.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete the diagnostic build tag after the physical-head topology receipt is current.

entries.gate: The emergency route remains available and passes its compile-out proof.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete the fallback control only after the compact route becomes the default with release evidence.

entries.gate: C-comparable merge counts and representation joins remain visible during graduation.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete merge-only census code after the locked-C topology receipt is complete.

entries.gate: Recovery and ordinary ambiguity use separate C-equivalent derivation decisions.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete derivation census code after the ambiguity receipt covers every registered witness.

entries.gate: End-of-file recovery admission uses locked C events and the published tree.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete end-of-file admission diagnostics after all supported EOF shapes match C.

entries.gate: End-of-file acceptance history remains comparable with C.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete EOF history census code after the final EOF receipt is current.

entries.gate: The EOF shadow path does not mutate the production route.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete the EOF shadow after admission and retention receipts cover every EOF case.

entries.gate: The selected-store fast path preserves exact trees before performance measurement.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete the experiment tag after the release benchmark receipt replaces it.

entries.gate: Recovery fallback and retention telemetry stay within release limits.
entries.deletion_condition: Keep stable release telemetry; delete only temporary fields after the release receipt.

entries.gate: The C comparison harness records exact tree, range, error, and incremental results.
entries.deletion_condition: Keep the parity harness while any supported grammar lacks a current C receipt.

entries.gate: Performance scans use the same isolated C reference and stable settings.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete temporary scan controls after the release performance receipt.

entries.gate: Candidate admission remains explicit and observable.
entries.deletion_condition: Remove the candidate override after compact admission is the default.

entries.gate: Admission counters identify the executed route.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete the admission census after certification has a stable replacement metric.

entries.gate: The certification scorecard records exact route outcomes.
entries.deletion_condition: Retain the scorecard until every supported grammar has a current receipt.

entries.gate: Strict scorecard mode fails on an unapproved mismatch.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete strict-mode plumbing after the certification gate is permanent.

entries.gate: The scorecard ratchet prevents silent regression.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete the ratchet only when a permanent certification store replaces it.

entries.gate: Real-corpus admission runs only when the isolated receipt requests it.
entries.deletion_condition: Keep the control for repeatable certification and remove it after the workflow is permanent.

entries.gate: The real-corpus manifest remains authenticated.
entries.deletion_condition: Keep the manifest selector while the locked corpus is external.

entries.gate: Certification selects languages without changing the locked corpus.
entries.deletion_condition: Retain the selector until the full language receipt is complete.

entries.gate: Excluded languages are recorded instead of silently omitted.
entries.deletion_condition: Remove exclusions only through an updated authenticated corpus policy.

entries.gate: Corpus buckets partition certification without changing source identity.
entries.deletion_condition: Keep bucket selection until all partitions have current receipts.

entries.gate: A byte limit is explicit and visible in the receipt.
entries.deletion_condition: Remove the limit only after the full corpus run fits the release budget.

entries.gate: The real-corpus ratchet blocks an unreviewed regression.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete the ratchet only after permanent certification storage exists.

entries.gate: The parser memory budget remains explicit during release runs.
entries.deletion_condition: Keep the budget control as a release safety contract.

entries.gate: The hard memory ceiling prevents runaway retention.
entries.deletion_condition: Keep the ceiling control as a release safety contract.

entries.gate: The graph-structured stack cap is measured before it changes.
entries.deletion_condition: Move the cap into an authenticated profile after release evidence is complete.

entries.gate: The per-key merge cap remains visible in the performance receipt.
entries.deletion_condition: Move the cap into an authenticated profile after the merge receipt is complete.

entries.gate: Recovery policy follows the authenticated language profile.
entries.deletion_condition: Remove the override after every recovery policy is profile-owned.

entries.gate: Diagnostic node-limit scaling stays isolated from release measurements.
entries.deletion_condition: Delete diagnostic scaling after all full-parse receipts use the release budget.
